title: eulophia recurva
intro: Eulophia recurva, commonly known as the twisted orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Eulophia recurva are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Eulophia recurva include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
